verdict.rationale: Linear has its own integration directory at linear.app/integrations. It lists many first- and third-party apps (GitHub, Slack, Figma, Sentry, Datadog, Salesforce, Notion, Fivetran, Airbyte, Cursor, Devin and others), third-party developers can submit apps to it, and admins can approve apps before installation. The evidence shows a curated catalog of dozens of integrations, not 'thousands', so the scale in the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: evidence of a marketplace with thousands of apps, independent or hands-on corroboration of the directory's breadth and install experience.
